summary: SR Bancorp, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on June 18, 2026, announcing its Board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.06 per share, a $0.01 or 20% increase from the prior dividend. The dividend will be paid on July 15, 2026 to shareholders of record as of June 30, 2026. As the issuer, the company highlights its earnings strength and commitment to shareholder value. No other special-situation mechanics (e.g., tender, restructuring, acquisition) are present. This is a routine dividend increase disclosure, thus classified under Capital Returns.
